The Ciliberto 2003 morphogenesis project from biosimulations.org (run `61fea4948edd56f301e6a7fc`), task `task_1`,
translated by process-bigraph-lang's `sedml translate` once per solver (`registry/solvers.yaml`), with this
service's output directory (`/experiment/output`). Each archive holds the compiled document (`task_1.pbg`), its text
and the changed model. Used by tests/simulators/test_sedml.py, the gate for biosim-toolkit at level `tested`.
